method: Complete pinned source read and Git/SHA256 verification. Original AST size methods executed using fake spin/unit widgets, no settings mutation.
findings: FileSizeSpinButton supports exponents0..5. _set_exponent falls through to last enum for unknown exponent without rescaling coefficient. Original control roundtrip1024^6 returns1024^5; UINT64_MAX returns18014398509481984. This includes schema default maximum, but actual GTK signal/clamp/persistence outcome remains unqualified.
Negative exponent also falls through to5, so decrementing unit below Byte jumps to Petabyte. No real wrapping event executed.
set_bytes uses floating log/division, losing exact integer precision for large values; min/max UI must not be treated as lossless uint64 representation.
Spin numeric range1..1023 and wrap semantics differ from set_bytes zero/fractional display state. Stub control intentionally does not model GTK clamping or notify ordering.
Range requires strict min<max and adjusts by one byte, whereas exact-size filtering often needs inclusive equal bounds. This UI restriction is separate from scanner CLI capabilities.
NodeState keep logic uses identity comparison on integer constants; ordinary current small-int behavior is not a proof for arbitrary equivalent numeric objects. No action-state failure claimed.

View.show_progress documents pulse for None but only reveals widget and skips fraction update; it does not call pulse. Previously read finish handler passes100 into direct set_fraction wrapper, outside usual fraction convention; actual GTK behavior not executed.
CurrentChoiceLabel interpolates unescaped choice into markup; currently schema/static labels bound exposure. remove_header_widget list.remove can raise despite documented no-op intent.

MultipleChoiceButton registers same popup click behavior twice; programmatic selection does not emit row-selected. External-setting synchronization and repeated callbacks require actual GUI qualification.
Datetime formatting uses local naive timestamps and future-day offsets may produce ago labels. Human-readable size formatting is display-only and must not establish exact file-size equality.

executed_control.scope: Original AST size conversion methods with fake widgets; no GTK clamping/signals or settings persistence.

limits: No GUI runtime, persistent setting update, upstream suite or production optimization.
